purpose: Tiered indicator list for scanning the WebText sample for material from non-western state-linked influence operations. Every entry carries its public-record attribution. Tier is an evidence class, not a severity: finding Tier A content in the corpus supports the coordinated-amplification reading much more strongly than finding Tier B content, because Tier A assets had little organic audience and documented inauthentic distribution, while Tier B outlets plausibly clear a 3-karma gate organically.
window_note: WebText contains outbound Reddit links posted up to December 2017 (Radford et al. 2019, section 2.1). Attribution dates may postdate the window (many do: 2018-2021); what matters for presence is that the asset was ACTIVE and publishing in-window. Entries whose activity began after the window are excluded by construction and noted in coverage_notes.

tiers.A: Attributed covert influence-operation asset: a site or persona publicly attributed to a state influence apparatus by a government, platform, or named forensic investigation.
tiers.B: Overt state media of a non-western state: openly state-owned or state-directed outlets. Presence in the corpus establishes the pipeline admitted state content, not that its karma was inauthentic.
tiers.C: Documented amplifier/proxy: not state organs, but outlets repeatedly documented as laundering or amplifying state influence-operation content.
tiers.M: Meta-discussion marker: vocabulary of coverage ABOUT influence operations. Measures how much the corpus talks about the war, as a contrast to carrying its munitions.
tiers.BASE: Baseline comparator for rate context: mainstream outlets (plus one deliberately chosen state-funded-but-normalized comparator, Al Jazeera). Not part of the hypothesis.

coverage_notes: China, covert (Tier A): empty by scope, not by finding. The documented covert Chinese English-language networks (e.g. the network Graphika later named 'Spamouflage Dragon', reported from 2019) postdate the WebText window; no public attribution names pre-2018 covert Chinese web assets in English that this study could locate. The Chinese entries here are therefore all Tier B overt state media.

Russian-language Prigozhin media-arm sentinels (riafan.ru, politexpert.net) are expected to be near-null in a Reddit-outbound English-dominated corpus; they are included so that the null is a recorded check rather than an unasked question. Sister sites of the same group (nevnov.ru, inforeactor.ru, nation-news.ru, newinform.com, slovodel.com) are omitted as redundant with the two sentinels.
North Korean state domains are included as expected-null sentinels for the same reason.

Persona/page-brand phrases (Blacktivist, Heart of Texas, ...) will overwhelmingly surface in press coverage ABOUT the operations. They are scanned to find any document that embeds or reproduces operation content, and every hit is classified origin-vs-mention rather than counted naively.
